source.label: prop:rucb
source.quote: Suppose that the distributions $\nu_1, \hdots, \nu_K$ are such that the mean estimator satisfies Assumption \ref{ass:est} for all $i=1,\ldots,K$. Then the regret of the Robust {\sc ucb} policy satisfies R_n \leq \sum_{i : \Delta_i > 0} (2c (v/\Delta_i)^{1/\epsilon} \log n + 5\Delta_i)

results.notes: Generic result under estimator Assumption 1, not strictly the s1 moment condition; attached to s1 as closest setting.

extra_assumptions: Mean estimator satisfies Assumption 1 for every arm's distribution

source.label: prop:rucb
source.quote: Also, if $n$ is such that $\log n \ge \max_i \left(5\Delta_i^{(1+\epsilon)/\epsilon}\big/(2cv^{1/\epsilon})\right)$, then R_n \leq n^{\frac{1}{1+\epsilon}} (4Kc\log n)^{\frac{\epsilon}{1+\epsilon}} v^{1/(1+\epsilon)}

results.notes: Regime condition depends on gaps, so 'worst-case' only in the stated regime.

source.label: th:truncated
source.quote: Let $\epsilon \in (0,1]$ and $u>0$. Assume that the reward distributions $\nu_1, \hdots, \nu_K$ satisfy E|X_i|^{1+\epsilon} \leq u. Then the regret of the Robust-{\sc ucb} policy used with the truncated mean estimator defined above satisfies R_n \leq \sum_{i : \Delta_i > 0} (8 (4u/\Delta_i)^{1/\epsilon} \log n + 5\Delta_i).

results.notes: Truncated mean has constant time per update per discussion.

extra_assumptions: Algorithm has E T_2(n) = o(n^a) for all a>0 on all two-armed problems with raw moment <= 1

source.label: th:mm
source.quote: Let $\epsilon \in (0,1]$ and $v>0$. Assume that the reward distributions satisfy E|X-\mu_i|^{1+\epsilon} \leq v. Then the regret of the Robust-{\sc ucb} policy used with the median-of-means mean estimator defined in Lemma \ref{lem:3} satisfies R_n \leq \sum_{i : \Delta_i > 0} (32 (12v/\Delta_i)^{1/\epsilon} \log n + 5\Delta_i)

results.notes: Theorem numbering inferred; both median-of-means and Catoni theorems share label th:mm in source.

symbols.v: known upper bound on reward variances

source.label: th:mm
source.quote: Let $v>0$. Assume that the reward distributions $\nu_1, \hdots, \nu_K$ satisfy E|X-\mu_i|^2 \leq v. Then the regret of the modified robust {\sc ucb} policy satisfies R_n \leq \sum_{i : \Delta_i > 0} (\frac{8v\log n}{\Delta_i} + 8\Delta_i \log n+ 5\Delta_i)

results.notes: Catoni estimator requires linear space per update; still polynomial.
